statement: 以后我说的 GMV，都按商品金额加运费（price + freight_value）计算，按客户实际收货时间 order_delivered_customer_date 归属月份，只算 order_status='delivered' 的订单。

arguments.note: 按客户实际收货时间 order_delivered_customer_date 归属月份

## 用户已确认的指标口径（跨会话记忆）
用户问到下列指标时按此口径生成 SQL，并在回答中说明使用了哪条记忆：
- GMV = SUM(price + freight_value)；时间字段 order_delivered_customer_date；过滤 order_status='delivered'（记忆 #1，确认于 2026-11-22，来源会话 probe-session-1）

cases.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value), 2) AS gmv
FROM olist_orders o
JOIN olist_order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01'

SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 0), 2) AS gmv
FROM olist_order_items oi
JOIN olist_orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date >= '2017-11-01'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date < '2017-12-01'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value), 2) AS gmv
FROM olist_orders o
JOIN olist_order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01'

WITH order_payments AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS payment_value
    FROM olist_order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(op.payment_value), 2) AS gmv
FROM olist_orders o
JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01'
